daily.title: Trump envoys arrive in Kyiv in new push to end Russia’s war
daily.summary: The visit follows the U.S. officials' more than three hours of talks in Moscow on Saturday that a Kremlin aide called "highly useful."

daily.title: Chubu Electric chairman Satoru Katsuno may step down over data fraud
daily.summary: Industry officials have criticized Katsuno, with some saying that "there is no way he can remain in the position."

daily.title: Justice Ministry to test GPS tracking of sex offenders on parole
daily.summary: Only parolees who consent to participate in the program will be monitored with GPS devices, which are not slated to be attached to parolees' bodies.

daily.title: Japan adopts measures to stamp out invasive longhorn beetle
daily.summary: "We will engage in systematic and wide-area pest control to enable its eradication in Japan,"  Environment Minister Hirotaka Ishihara said.

daily.title: How a billion-dollar sanctions dodge kept Chinese goods flowing to Iran
daily.summary: The secretive trade mechanism, in which Iranian oil is exchanged for credits for Chinese imports, has provided a financial lifeline for Tehran.

daily.title: Actor and narrator Reo Morimoto dies at 83
daily.summary: The Japanese actor and narrator known for his gentle voice, died suddenly of an unknown cause earlier this month.

daily.title: Pakistan faces pressure to pick a side as Saudi tensions with Houthis escalate
daily.summary: Fighting between Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement and Saudi forces is increasingly testing how long Pakistan can hold both positions at once.

daily.title: At Dallas convention, some loyalists question Trump-centric midterms strategy

daily.title: China threat erodes Japanese anger over U.S. bases ahead of vote
daily.summary: Voters in Okinawa have long bristled over hosting U.S. military bases, but a growing acceptance for a stronger military to counter threats from China is changing the calculus.

daily.title: Diving into Japan’s art scene, one fair at a time
daily.summary: Usually bringing together hundreds of artists and galleries in one place, art fairs remove the distance, making viewing and comparing a vast array of artworks possible.

daily.title: Japan designates 18 regions as green transformation strategy areas

daily.title: China to raise visa fees sevenfold for Japanese visitors
daily.summary: The decision came after Japan introduced higher visa fees for foreign nationals in July.

daily.title: Former Sega president recalls being ‘impressed’ with Nvidia’s Huang

daily.title: BOJ set to raise interest rate to 1.25% next week
daily.summary: The last time the Bank of Japan's policy interest rate stood at 1.25% was in April 1995.

daily.title: North Korea fires off ‘multiple’ missiles, a day after trilateral exercises end

daily.title: Apple’s foldable iPhone poses a $1,999 question: Who is it for?

daily.title: Behind the killer robots of Ukraine’s new warfare ‘revolution’

weekly.summary: The survey results highlighted a declining desire for marriage as more people see few benefits to tying the knot.

weekly.title: Double-dipping: When one manga adaptation just isn’t enough

weekly.summary: A preliminary analysis found that a lingering squall-line system — which usually moves quickly — contributed to August's deadly downpours.

weekly.summary: Japan's currency is being buffeted by many forces, and debate rages as to whether the tide has turned.
